about.title: Dan Sorenson, ISA Certified Arborist
paragraphs: Treekeeper Tree Service Inc. was established in 1985 by Dan Sorenson, and has served the Portland metro area ever since. We are licensed, bonded and insured, Oregon CCB #67935.

Dan is an ISA Certified Arborist (#PN-0234A). To earn certification he passed a lengthy exam covering tree biology, plant health care, tree risk assessment and safety, and he keeps it up through continuing education.
We go out on a limb to provide customer satisfaction.

services.name: Tree Removal
services.blurb: Trees of all sizes, including tight spots near homes and power lines.
services.intro: Sometimes, because of poor health or landscape design, trees have to be removed. It's important to use an expert, especially in dangerous or tight-spot removals near power lines, homes and other structures. We use rigging, boom trucks, good old-fashioned climbing and hand-cutting, or a combination. Depending on your preference, we cut the tree into firewood or larger pieces, or remove it altogether. Either way, we pride ourselves on a complete cleanup.
includes: Firewood or full haul-away, your choice
photos: Climber taking down a tall tree in sections
Fallen fir in a front yard

services.name: Tree Trimming & Pruning
services.blurb: Pruned to ISA standards for health, safety and looks.
services.intro: Anyone can take a trimming tool to a tree, but that doesn't mean it's done right. Proper pruning improves the health and appearance of trees and prolongs their life. Dead, dying or diseased wood is removed, shape is enhanced, and limbs can be raised to clear height, all in accordance with ISA (International Society of Arboriculture) standards. We also prune and trim fruit trees.
photos: Climber working high in a bare tree

services.name: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.blurb: Overgrown laurels and hedges brought back under control.
services.intro: Because of the Northwest climate, hedges and shrubs can grow out of control quickly. We have experience with all types and sizes of hedges and take seasonal growth into account for each one, saving you time (and your back and neck). We offer a free, no-obligation quote, and all quotes include clean-up and removal of hedge cuttings.
includes: All types and sizes of hedges

services.name: Stump Grinding
services.blurb: Stumps ground up to 18 inches below grade.
services.intro: Stump grinding is simply the most effective way to remove tree stumps. We can grind your stump at the time of your tree removal or come back later. Stumps can be ground up to 18 inches below grade, and the grindings can be raked back into the hole, left for you to use as mulch, or hauled away.

services.name: Emergency Tree Removal
services.blurb: Storm damage and dangerous trees, when time is critical.
services.intro: When a storm brings a tree down on a house, a car or a sidewalk, time is critical. We're available for emergencies and dangerous tree removals, and we leave the site cleaned up.

services.name: Tree Permits
services.blurb: Help with the permit rules in your city or county.
services.intro: Many cities and counties around Portland require a permit to remove a tree, and Heritage Trees are protected by city code. Ask us about the rules where you live before the work starts.
